title: UX Course Map Skeleton Cleanup: repeated short labels are repaired

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.142 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.142 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow Course Map skeleton repair; focused coverage plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on fresh deployed v0.15.141 ZIP/log evidence. A fresh deployed v0.15.142 audit is required before claiming this cleanup in real provider output.

claims.summary: Fresh deployed v0.15.141 UX evidence exported successfully and locally regraded at 99/A with zero P0/P1/P2 findings; the only scored loss was texture 92.
The v0.15.141 package collapsed Course Map lesson titles, filenames, and support text around repeated short labels such as design project and weekly studio critiques.
proofCommands: rg -n "Lesson NN - design project|weekly studio critiques|complete-looking Course Map rows" docs/V0.15.142_UX_COURSE_MAP_SKELETON_CLEANUP_ROADMAP.md

claims.summary: Course Map readiness treats repeated short labels across many lessons as weak skeleton content before they seed filenames or deliverables.
Collapsed UX studio maps fall back to a lesson-specific progression instead of repeating design project.
proofCommands: rg -n "UX_DESIGN_TOPIC_SEQUENCE|UX problem framing and studio orientation|portfolio case reflection and handoff" src/lib/deliverableReadiness.js tests/v015141-ux-texture-regression.test.js

claims.summary: Focused regression reproduces the v0.15.141 design project / weekly studio critiques collapse and proves the repaired map varies across 12 lessons.
proofCommands: rg -n "repairs repeated short UX skeleton topics|design project|weekly studio critiques" tests/v015141-ux-texture-regression.test.js

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.142 ZIP/log audit must prove the repeated short-label repair in real provider output.
Texture can still remain below 100 if another deterministic repeated family appears after this skeleton fix.
Source rows must remain real, trusted, on-topic, license-safe, and concept-linked across UX and Project Management domains.
The exporter and UI must keep caveated packages amber/with notes rather than presenting review-needed packages as clean green.
